text: DSH Claude Desktop Theme 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Claude Desktop 风格主题插件。它通过客户端 theme 服务覆盖界面设计 token，提供暖砂画布、赤陶强调色与 Anthropic 字体优先的字体栈，并同时定义浅色和深色取值，由 DSH 外观偏好决定当前方案。覆盖包括界面表面、文字、按钮、聊天输入与气泡、Markdown 和代码高亮等视觉元素。适合希望让 DSH 界面呈现温暖中性色调的用户；不需要额外配置 API Key 或外部服务。

DSH Claude Desktop Theme gives the DSH web client a Claude inspired look with warm sand surfaces, terracotta accents, and Anthropic first fonts. Light and dark theme tokens follow DSH appearance preferences across chat, Markdown, and code. No API key or external service is required.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成 Claude Desktop 那种暖色主题。
DSH 能不能用暖砂底色和赤陶色按钮？
Can I give the DSH web interface a warm Claude Desktop inspired theme?
DSH Claude Desktop Theme 的功能「浅色与深色暖砂配色」：为界面 token 同时提供浅色暖砂画布和深色暖炭画布，并配以赤陶主色。当前方案由 DSH 的外观偏好选择，覆盖表面、按钮、文字和聊天区域等样式。
DSH Claude Desktop Theme 的功能「Anthropic 字体排印」：为正文、Markdown 标题和代码定义优先使用 Anthropic Sans、Serif、Mono 的字体栈，并在字体不可用时回退到系统字体。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop：参考 [Claude Desktop](https://claude.ai) 界面风格、以及仓库
[gongshiyun/openchamber-claude-desktop-theme](https://github.com/gongshiyun/openchamber-claude-desktop-theme)
（其配色又源自思源主题 [frostime/sy-theme-siyaude（砂源）](https://github.com/frostime/sy-theme-siyaude)）
为 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 制作的客户端主题插件：

**暖砂画布 + 赤陶主色的浅色 / 深色双变体，外加一整套 Anthropic 字体排印层。**

> 上面两张是按 DSH 界面结构生成的**示意图**（`node tools/make-mock.mjs` → `docs/mock-*.html`），
> 文案全部虚构；颜色直接读 `lib/client.js` 的 token 表，所以不会和主题脱节。
> 真实截图会暴露工作区名与对话内容，因此仓库里不放。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 特性：| | |
|---|---|
| **明暗双变体** | 两套取值同时注册，切换由 DSH 内置的「设置 → 通用 → 外观」（浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统）驱动，插件本身不持有任何主题状态，也就不会和系统跟随、首屏 bootstrap、`theme-color` 元信息打架。 |
| **覆盖完整** | 共 133 个 token：90 个 `--dsw-alias-*` 语义 token **100% 覆盖**，外加 11 个 `--dsw-specific-*`、被组件直接消费的 18 个 `--dsw-static-*`、11 个 `--shiki-*` 语法色，以及字体排印层。 |
| **字体排印** | 界面 Anthropic Sans、标题 Anthropic Serif（H1–H3 衬线）、代码 Anthropic Mono；没装字体时优雅回退到 Segoe UI / Georgia / Cascadia Code，中文各自接思源与系统黑体、宋体。 |
| **字号设置兼容** | 标题字阶完整保留 `--dsh-content-font-delta` 增量，「设置 → 通用 → 内容字号」的 12–17px 调节照常生效。 |
| **零残留** | `overrideTokens` 返回的 disposer 挂在插件 fiber 上，禁用或卸载插件即刻回到内置配色。 |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 安装：插件是一个普通的「双半边」npm 包：host 半边（`lib/index.js`）只提供一条可挂载的组合条目，
全部逻辑在 client 半边（`lib/client.js`）。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 方式 A：按 bundle 依赖安装：```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"        # Windows: C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop
```

本包的 `package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`
引用它时会自动把条目插入组合树。
section: 方式 A：按 bundle 依赖安装

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 方式 B：只在某个 profile 里挂一条（本机验证用的方式）：在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 顶层加上：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: theme-claude-desktop
      name: '@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop'
```

保存后 DSH 会热加载这条 patch，无需重启。用 `Settings → 插件` 或
`plugin_manager list_plugins` 可以看到 `include:theme-claude-desktop` 处于 `active`。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 切换明暗：**设置 → 通用 → 外观** 里选「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」即可 —— 这正是本插件选择
「token 覆盖层」而不是「注册两个第三方主题」的原因：第三方主题 id 不进内置外观设置的
schema，重启就会丢；而覆盖层直接跟着内置偏好走，明暗与跟随系统全部免费获得。

想恢复默认配色，把插件禁用（`Settings → 插件`）或从 `cordis.patch.yml` 里删掉那一行即可。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 字体：三段字体栈都遵循「Anthropic 字体优先 → 本机近似字体 → 通用族」：

| 用途 | 首选 | 回退链 |
|---|---|---|
| 界面正文 | Anthropic Sans Text / Anthropic Sans | Styrene B → Segoe UI Variable Text → Segoe UI → PingFang SC → Microsoft YaHei UI → Noto Sans SC |
| 标题（H1–H3） | Anthropic Serif Text / Anthropic Serif | Copernicus → Tiempos Text → Georgia → Noto Serif SC → 宋体 |
| 代码 | Anthropic Mono | Cascadia Code → JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → Consolas |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 字体：**装了 Anthropic 字体就自动生效，不用改配置**。安装方式见
[matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts](https://github.com/matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts)；
Windows 上把 ttf 装到「为所有用户安装」后重启 DSH 即可。

`FONT_SERIF` 换成 `FONT_SANS` 就行（这三条是 `font` 简写，必须整条重写，只改
`-font-family` 子 token 不会影响实际渲染 —— 这一点在文件头注释里有说明）。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 配色：完整色板（含每个 token 的明暗取值、语义状态色、代码高亮色）见
**[docs/preview.html](docs/preview.html)**（可直接用浏览器打开）或渲染好的
[docs/preview.png](docs/preview.png)：

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 已知限制：- **首屏仍用内置配色**：加载页的 `--dsh-boot-*` 由 host 在 index 响应里注入，第三方
  插件拿不到，所以从启动到 client 插件挂载之间会有一次极短的色差（通常只有一帧）。
  首屏之后的 `theme-color` 元信息会跟随实际渲染的 body 背景。
- **个别硬编码颜色不随主题变化**：例如 hovercard 的 `#2C2C2E` 是写在组件样式里的常量，
  不是 token。这类位置只能等上游把它 token 化。
- **`--dsw-static-*` 是「与配色无关」的常量**：本插件只改了被组件直接消费的 18 个
  （如文件卡片的 `neutral-50/850`），给的是能同时成立的中性暖值，而不是逐明暗切换的值。
- **第三方主题 id 不进内置外观 schema**：因此本插件不做 `ctx.theme.register()`，
  只做 `overrideTokens()`。

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 开发：```bash
node tools/validate.mjs             # 校验 token 表：成对取值、命名存在、调色板无冗余、alias 层覆盖率
node tools/make-preview.mjs         # 由 token 表生成 docs/preview.html（色板）
node tools/make-mock.mjs            # 由 token 表生成 docs/mock-light.html / docs/mock-dark.html（README 示意图）
node tools/extract-base-tokens.mjs  # 从本机 ui-theme bundle 重新抽取内置 token 清单（升级 DSH 后核对）

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Windows：抓一张当前 DSH 桌面端窗口截图（Web GUI 需要带 token 的 URL，直连会 401）：.\tools\capture-dsh-window.ps1 -Out shot.png
```

渲染两份 HTML 用无头 Chrome 即可（示意图建议 2 倍像素密度）：

```bash
chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars \
  --force-device-scale-factor=2 --window-size=1224,788 \
  --screenshot=docs/mock-light.png docs/mock-light.html
```

`lib/client.js` 的结构是：字体栈 → 明/暗两套调色板常量 → token 表 → `apply()`。
改配色只动调色板常量即可，`tools/validate.mjs` 会拦住写错的键名。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop：A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** client theme plugin modelled on the
[Claude Desktop](https://claude.ai) look, ported from
[gongshiyun/openchamber-claude-desktop-theme](https://github.com/gongshiyun/openchamber-claude-desktop-theme)
(whose palette in turn comes from the SiYuan theme
[frostime/sy-theme-siyaude](https://github.com/frostime/sy-theme-siyaude)):

**warm-sand canvas + terracotta accent, in both a light and a dark variant, plus a full
Anthropic typography layer.**

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop：> Both images above are **generated mock-ups** of the DSH layout
> (`node tools/make-mock.mjs` → `docs/mock-*.html`) with entirely fictional copy. Their colours
> are read straight from the token table in `lib/client.js`, so they cannot drift from the theme.
> Real screenshots would expose workspace names and conversation content, so this repo ships

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · What you get：| | |
|---|---|
| **Both variants at once** | Light and dark values are registered together; switching is driven by DSH's own *Settings → General → Appearance* (Light / Dark / Follow system). The plugin holds no theme state, so `system` following, the pre-plugin bootstrap and the `theme-color` metadata keep working untouched. |
| **Complete coverage** | 133 tokens: all 90 `--dsw-alias-*` semantic tokens, 11 `--dsw-specific-*`, the 18 `--dsw-static-*` values that components consume directly, 11 `--shiki-*` syntax colours, and the typography layer. |
| **Typography** | Anthropic Sans for UI, Anthropic Serif for H1–H3, Anthropic Mono for code — with graceful fallbacks to Segoe UI / Georgia / Cascadia Code, and CJK fallbacks to Noto Sans/Serif SC and the system Song/Hei faces. |
| **Font-size setting preserved** | The heading ladder keeps its `--dsh-content-font-delta` increments, so the 12–17 px *Content font size* setting still works. |
| **No residue** | The disposer returned by `overrideTokens` is attached to the plugin fiber: disabling or unloading the plugin restores the built-in palette immediately. |

```

`dsh.profile.bundles` inserts the entry automatically.

text:
@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Switching light / dark：**Settings → General → Appearance** → *Light / Dark / Follow system*.

This is exactly why the plugin uses a **token override layer** instead of registering two
third-party themes: third-party theme ids never enter the built-in Appearance settings
schema and are lost on restart, whereas an override layer rides the built-in preference
and gets light/dark/system for free.

To go back to the default palette, disable the plugin (`Settings → Plugins`) or remove the
entry from `cordis.patch.yml`.

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Fonts：All three stacks prefer the Anthropic faces, then local lookalikes, then generic families:

| Role | Preferred | Fallback chain |
|---|---|---|
| UI text | Anthropic Sans Text / Anthropic Sans | Styrene B → Segoe UI Variable Text → Segoe UI → PingFang SC → Microsoft YaHei UI → Noto Sans SC |
| Headings (H1–H3) | Anthropic Serif Text / Anthropic Serif | Copernicus → Tiempos Text → Georgia → Noto Serif SC → SimSun |
| Code | Anthropic Mono | Cascadia Code → JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → Consolas |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Fonts：For **all-sans headings**, replace `FONT_SERIF` with `FONT_SANS` in the three
`--dsw-font-markdown-h1/h2/h3` entries of `lib/client.js` (those are `font` shorthands, so
the whole value must be rewritten — overriding only the `-font-family` sub-token has no
effect, as noted in the file header).

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Palette：| Role | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Canvas `bg-base` | `#FFFAF2` | `#26221E` |
| Sidebar `sidebar-fill` | `#F3EBDD` | `#1E1A16` |
| Composer `input-major` | `#FFFDF9` | `#2E2721` |
| User bubble `bubble` | `#F6E7D8` | `#332B24` |
| Body text `label-primary` | `#3A2E24` | `#E2D9CC` |
| Secondary text `label-secondary` | `#776450` | `#A39684` |
| Accent `brand-primary` | `#B85430` | `#DF805B` |
| Link | `#3B6A89` | `#95BFD0` |
| Success / warning / error | `#4A7350` / `#96651C` / `#A94636` | `#A6C896` / `#E3BC72` / `#E48270` |
| Code block `markdown-code-block` | `#F8F1E6` | `#201B17` |

**[docs/preview.html](docs/preview.html)** (open it in a browser) or the rendered

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Known limitations：- **First paint still uses the built-in palette.** The loading page's `--dsh-boot-*` values
  are injected by the host into the index response and are out of reach for a third-party
  plugin, so there is a very brief (usually single-frame) colour shift between startup and
  this plugin mounting. After that, the `theme-color` metadata follows the rendered body.
- **A few hard-coded colours do not follow the theme** — e.g. the hovercard's `#2C2C2E` is a
  constant in a component stylesheet, not a token.
- **`--dsw-static-*` are scheme-invariant constants.** Only the 18 that components consume
  directly are overridden (e.g. the deliverables card's `neutral-50/850`), and they get
  mid-tone warm values that hold up in both schemes rather than per-scheme values.
- **Third-party theme ids never enter the built-in Appearance schema**, which is why this
  plugin calls `overrideTokens()` rather than `ctx.theme.register()`.

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Development：```bash
node tools/validate.mjs             # token table: paired values, known names, no unused palette keys, alias coverage
node tools/make-preview.mjs         # regenerate docs/preview.html (the colour board)
node tools/make-mock.mjs            # regenerate docs/mock-light.html / docs/mock-dark.html (the README mock-ups)
node tools/extract-base-tokens.mjs  # re-extract the built-in token list from the local ui-theme bundle (after a DSH upgrade)

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Windows: capture the running DSH desktop window (the Web GUI needs its tokenised URL; a bare request gets 401)：.\tools\capture-dsh-window.ps1 -Out shot.png
```

Render either HTML with headless Chrome (2× device scale for the mock-ups):

```bash
chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars \
  --force-device-scale-factor=2 --window-size=1224,788 \
  --screenshot=docs/mock-light.png docs/mock-light.html
```

| **零残留** | `overrideTokens` 返回的 disposer 挂在插件 fiber 上，禁用或卸载插件即刻回到内置配色。 |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 安装：插件是一个普通的「双半边」npm 包：host 半边（`lib/index.js`）只提供一条可挂载的组合条目，
全部逻辑在 client 半边（`lib/client.js`）。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 方式 A：按 bundle 依赖安装：```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"        # Windows: C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop
```

本包的 `package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`
引用它时会自动把条目插入组合树。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 切换明暗：**设置 → 通用 → 外观** 里选「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」即可 —— 这正是本插件选择
「token 覆盖层」而不是「注册两个第三方主题」的原因：第三方主题 id 不进内置外观设置的
schema，重启就会丢；而覆盖层直接跟着内置偏好走，明暗与跟随系统全部免费获得。

想恢复默认配色，把插件禁用（`Settings → 插件`）或从 `cordis.patch.yml` 里删掉那一行即可。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 字体：三段字体栈都遵循「Anthropic 字体优先 → 本机近似字体 → 通用族」：

| 用途 | 首选 | 回退链 |
|---|---|---|
| 界面正文 | Anthropic Sans Text / Anthropic Sans | Styrene B → Segoe UI Variable Text → Segoe UI → PingFang SC → Microsoft YaHei UI → Noto Sans SC |
| 标题（H1–H3） | Anthropic Serif Text / Anthropic Serif | Copernicus → Tiempos Text → Georgia → Noto Serif SC → 宋体 |
| 代码 | Anthropic Mono | Cascadia Code → JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → Consolas |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 字体：**装了 Anthropic 字体就自动生效，不用改配置**。安装方式见
[matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts](https://github.com/matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts)；
Windows 上把 ttf 装到「为所有用户安装」后重启 DSH 即可。

想改成**全无衬线标题**，把 `lib/client.js` 里 `--dsw-font-markdown-h1/h2/h3` 三处
`FONT_SERIF` 换成 `FONT_SANS` 就行（这三条是 `font` 简写，必须整条重写，只改
`-font-family` 子 token 不会影响实际渲染 —— 这一点在文件头注释里有说明）。

|---|---|---|
| 画布 `bg-base` | `#FFFAF2` | `#26221E` |
| 侧栏 `sidebar-fill` | `#F3EBDD` | `#1E1A16` |
| 输入卡片 `input-major` | `#FFFDF9` | `#2E2721` |

| 主色 `brand-primary` | `#B85430` | `#DF805B` |

| 成功 / 警告 / 错误 | `#4A7350` / `#96651C` / `#A94636` | `#A6C896` / `#E3BC72` / `#E48270` |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 配色：完整色板（含每个 token 的明暗取值、语义状态色、代码高亮色）见
**[docs/preview.html](docs/preview.html)**（可直接用浏览器打开）或渲染好的
[docs/preview.png](docs/preview.png)：

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 已知限制：- **首屏仍用内置配色**：加载页的 `--dsh-boot-*` 由 host 在 index 响应里注入，第三方
  插件拿不到，所以从启动到 client 插件挂载之间会有一次极短的色差（通常只有一帧）。
  首屏之后的 `theme-color` 元信息会跟随实际渲染的 body 背景。
- **个别硬编码颜色不随主题变化**：例如 hovercard 的 `#2C2C2E` 是写在组件样式里的常量，
  不是 token。这类位置只能等上游把它 token 化。
- **`--dsw-static-*` 是「与配色无关」的常量**：本插件只改了被组件直接消费的 18 个
  （如文件卡片的 `neutral-50/850`），给的是能同时成立的中性暖值，而不是逐明暗切换的值。
- **第三方主题 id 不进内置外观 schema**：因此本插件不做 `ctx.theme.register()`，
  只做 `overrideTokens()`。

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 开发：```bash
node tools/validate.mjs             # 校验 token 表：成对取值、命名存在、调色板无冗余、alias 层覆盖率
node tools/make-preview.mjs         # 由 token 表生成 docs/preview.html（色板）
node tools/make-mock.mjs            # 由 token 表生成 docs/mock-light.html / docs/mock-dark.html（README 示意图）
node tools/extract-base-tokens.mjs  # 从本机 ui-theme bundle 重新抽取内置 token 清单（升级 DSH 后核对）

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Windows：抓一张当前 DSH 桌面端窗口截图（Web GUI 需要带 token 的 URL，直连会 401）：.\tools\capture-dsh-window.ps1 -Out shot.png
```

渲染两份 HTML 用无头 Chrome 即可（示意图建议 2 倍像素密度）：

```bash
chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars \
  --force-device-scale-factor=2 --window-size=1224,788 \
  --screenshot=docs/mock-light.png docs/mock-light.html
```

`lib/client.js` 的结构是：字体栈 → 明/暗两套调色板常量 → token 表 → `apply()`。
改配色只动调色板常量即可，`tools/validate.mjs` 会拦住写错的键名。

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · 兼容性：- DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`（依赖 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` 与
  `dsh.client` 双半边包约定）
- 平台：`web`
- 依赖：仅 `theme` 一个 client service，不 require 任何外部模块（连 React 都不用）

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop：A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** client theme plugin modelled on the
[Claude Desktop](https://claude.ai) look, ported from
[gongshiyun/openchamber-claude-desktop-theme](https://github.com/gongshiyun/openchamber-claude-desktop-theme)
(whose palette in turn comes from the SiYuan theme
[frostime/sy-theme-siyaude](https://github.com/frostime/sy-theme-siyaude)):

**warm-sand canvas + terracotta accent, in both a light and a dark variant, plus a full
Anthropic typography layer.**

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · @gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop：> Both images above are **generated mock-ups** of the DSH layout
> (`node tools/make-mock.mjs` → `docs/mock-*.html`) with entirely fictional copy. Their colours
> are read straight from the token table in `lib/client.js`, so they cannot drift from the theme.
> Real screenshots would expose workspace names and conversation content, so this repo ships
> none.

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · What you get：| | |
|---|---|
| **Both variants at once** | Light and dark values are registered together; switching is driven by DSH's own *Settings → General → Appearance* (Light / Dark / Follow system). The plugin holds no theme state, so `system` following, the pre-plugin bootstrap and the `theme-color` metadata keep working untouched. |
| **Complete coverage** | 133 tokens: all 90 `--dsw-alias-*` semantic tokens, 11 `--dsw-specific-*`, the 18 `--dsw-static-*` values that components consume directly, 11 `--shiki-*` syntax colours, and the typography layer. |
| **Typography** | Anthropic Sans for UI, Anthropic Serif for H1–H3, Anthropic Mono for code — with graceful fallbacks to Segoe UI / Georgia / Cascadia Code, and CJK fallbacks to Noto Sans/Serif SC and the system Song/Hei faces. |
| **Font-size setting preserved** | The heading ladder keeps its `--dsh-content-font-delta` increments, so the 12–17 px *Content font size* setting still works. |
| **No residue** | The disposer returned by `overrideTokens` is attached to the plugin fiber: disabling or unloading the plugin restores the built-in palette immediately. |

```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so a profile listing it in
`dsh.profile.bundles` inserts the entry automatically.

```yaml

      name: '@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop'
```

DSH hot-loads the patch — no restart needed. `Settings → Plugins` (or

text:
@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Switching light / dark：**Settings → General → Appearance** → *Light / Dark / Follow system*.

This is exactly why the plugin uses a **token override layer** instead of registering two
third-party themes: third-party theme ids never enter the built-in Appearance settings
schema and are lost on restart, whereas an override layer rides the built-in preference
and gets light/dark/system for free.

To go back to the default palette, disable the plugin (`Settings → Plugins`) or remove the
entry from `cordis.patch.yml`.

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Fonts：All three stacks prefer the Anthropic faces, then local lookalikes, then generic families:

| Role | Preferred | Fallback chain |
|---|---|---|
| UI text | Anthropic Sans Text / Anthropic Sans | Styrene B → Segoe UI Variable Text → Segoe UI → PingFang SC → Microsoft YaHei UI → Noto Sans SC |
| Headings (H1–H3) | Anthropic Serif Text / Anthropic Serif | Copernicus → Tiempos Text → Georgia → Noto Serif SC → SimSun |
| Code | Anthropic Mono | Cascadia Code → JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → Consolas |

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Fonts：For **all-sans headings**, replace `FONT_SERIF` with `FONT_SANS` in the three
`--dsw-font-markdown-h1/h2/h3` entries of `lib/client.js` (those are `font` shorthands, so
the whole value must be rewritten — overriding only the `-font-family` sub-token has no
effect, as noted in the file header).

---

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Palette：| Role | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Canvas `bg-base` | `#FFFAF2` | `#26221E` |
| Sidebar `sidebar-fill` | `#F3EBDD` | `#1E1A16` |
| Composer `input-major` | `#FFFDF9` | `#2E2721` |
| User bubble `bubble` | `#F6E7D8` | `#332B24` |
| Body text `label-primary` | `#3A2E24` | `#E2D9CC` |
| Secondary text `label-secondary` | `#776450` | `#A39684` |
| Accent `brand-primary` | `#B85430` | `#DF805B` |
| Link | `#3B6A89` | `#95BFD0` |
| Success / warning / error | `#4A7350` / `#96651C` / `#A94636` | `#A6C896` / `#E3BC72` / `#E48270` |
| Code block `markdown-code-block` | `#F8F1E6` | `#201B17` |

**[docs/preview.html](docs/preview.html)** (open it in a browser) or the rendered
[docs/preview.png](docs/preview.png):

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Known limitations：- **First paint still uses the built-in palette.** The loading page's `--dsh-boot-*` values
  are injected by the host into the index response and are out of reach for a third-party
  plugin, so there is a very brief (usually single-frame) colour shift between startup and
  this plugin mounting. After that, the `theme-color` metadata follows the rendered body.
- **A few hard-coded colours do not follow the theme** — e.g. the hovercard's `#2C2C2E` is a
  constant in a component stylesheet, not a token.
- **`--dsw-static-*` are scheme-invariant constants.** Only the 18 that components consume
  directly are overridden (e.g. the deliverables card's `neutral-50/850`), and they get
  mid-tone warm values that hold up in both schemes rather than per-scheme values.
- **Third-party theme ids never enter the built-in Appearance schema**, which is why this
  plugin calls `overrideTokens()` rather than `ctx.theme.register()`.

@gongshiyun/dsh-theme-claude-desktop README · Development：```bash
node tools/validate.mjs             # token table: paired values, known names, no unused palette keys, alias coverage
node tools/make-preview.mjs         # regenerate docs/preview.html (the colour board)
node tools/make-mock.mjs            # regenerate docs/mock-light.html / docs/mock-dark.html (the README mock-ups)
node tools/extract-base-tokens.mjs  # re-extract the built-in token list from the local ui-theme bundle (after a DSH upgrade)

```
